positions.name: SlugGenerationAndFileCommitWorkflow
positions.frame: how does the pipeline generate slugs and commit files when submission payloads omit an explicit identifier?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the intake condition where an explicit id field is omitted, while src-2 specifies the pipeline requirement to generate a slug from content (via LLM id-gen or fallback) and successfully commit the resulting file.
